title: Quesadilla Salvadoreña
description: Quesadilla Salvadoreña is a dish from El Salvador featuring rice flour, queso fresco, whole cow milk, chicken egg. This home-sized recipe records each ingredient at the step where it is used. The version uses rice flour and available cheeses; locally traditional Salvadoran quesadilla may use specific hard cheese.

steps.instruction: Whisk the listed batter ingredients until smooth. Let the mixture rest briefly so the flour hydrates.
Combine the listed ingredients in a bowl until evenly mixed; avoid overworking delicate components.
Divide and shape the prepared mixture or dough into even portions and arrange on a lined baking sheet or appropriate molds, leaving enough room for expansion.
Bake the shaped or assembled mixture in a preheated oven for about 45 minutes until set and cooked through.
Serve the dish at the intended temperature and garnish as needed with previously prepared ingredients.
